jobs.title: Accounting Automation Engineer
jobs.raw_description: About us Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/ About the role We are hiring an Accounting Automation Engineer to replace manual accounting work across a multi-entity, multi-country enterprise, using Claude Code and agentic AI. You will use Claude Code and agentic AI, plus Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, to automate accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, month-end close and the wider day-to-day accounting operation. You need strong IFRS or US GAAP knowledge to get the numbers right, because an automation that posts wrong entries is worse than no automation. We build agentic AI systems and AI agents, not fixed step-by-step workflows. Experience with rule-based workflow builders such as n8n or Zapier is not relevant to this role. Titles we will consider: Accounting Automation Engineer, Finance Engineer, Financial Systems Engineer, Technical Accountant (with engineering background), Accounting Systems Manager (with engineering background). Key Responsibilities The goal is to automate the repeatable core of enterprise accounting, with human review kept only where judgment is needed. Accounts payable Invoice capture and data extraction from PDFs and email, using AI where useful Vendor matching, coding suggestions, and 2-way/3-way PO matching Duplicate invoice detection and approval routing Payment run preparation and vendor statement reconciliation Accounts receivable Invoice generation and delivery Cash application and bank receipt matching Aging reports, dunning and collections reminders Credit note handling and bad debt/ECL provision support Reconciliations Bank and card reconciliations across all accounts and currencies Balance sheet account reconciliations (prepayments, accruals, deferred revenue, fixed assets) Intercompany and subledger-to-GL reconciliations Exception reports that flag only the items a human needs to review Month-end close Close checklist tracking and scheduled reminders Recurring, accrual, prepayment and amortization journals Depreciation runs and FX revaluation Trial balance checks, flux/variance analysis, and draft commentary Management reporting packs General accounting...

jobs.raw_description: Who Should Apply We are looking for developers from all technical backgrounds and language specializations. If you write clean code and understand software design, you are a fit: Software Engineers & Computer Scientists specializing in algorithms, data structures, or system design. Full-Stack & Web Developers working with modern front-end or back-end frameworks (JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, PHP, Ruby, etc.). Backend & Systems Developers experienced in languages such as C++, Java, Go, Rust, or Python. DevOps & Database Engineers familiar with API design, SQL/NoSQL databases, or scripting. Role & Responsibilities As an AI Code Trainer , you will evaluate model-generated code, author reference solutions, and stress-test AI reasoning across various engineering domains. Code Auditing & Quality Analysis: Critique AI-generated solutions for logic, performance, security vulnerabilities, syntax, and coding best practices. Gold-Standard Solutions: Write clean, production-grade reference code and clear technical explanations for complex programming prompts. Test Design: Build unit tests and edge-case scenarios to evaluate model accuracy and expose edge-case failures. Technical Feedback: Write structured explanations detailing why an AI solution succeeds, fails, or produces bugs. Requirements Software Engineering Proficiency: Strong core fundamentals in at least one major programming language or web stack (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C++, Go, C#, Rust, PHP). Debugging & Code Review: Ability to quickly analyze third-party code, catch subtle logical errors, and evaluate efficiency. Technical Communication: Clear written English to explain technical concepts and code review rationales effectively. Eligible Locations: Resident of USA, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India, Pakistan, or Philippines . Why Join Us? $50–$125/hr commensurate with your technical domain expertise and task complexity. Weekly Guaranteed Payouts directly to your choice of PayPal or Payoneer . 100% Remote & Asynchronous: Total schedule control—work whenever and wherever you choose with no fixed minimum hours. How to Apply Apply directly on our website at https://codeforai.tech/
